detail: Redbrick Offices Limited has raised ₹530 crore through a combination of primary and secondary investments from a fundraise led by Abakkus Four2Eight Opportunities Fund, with participation from India SME, IIFL, Evolvence and UTI. Rajani Associates advised Redbrick on this fundraise. Saraf and Partners advised lead investor Abakkus on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Adil Ladha (Partner) and Rohan Shah (Partner), with support from Associates Rupam Das, Tanya Adani and Prantika Dutta.
